body:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: hosted-api p95/p99 spike detected in us-west-2, GPU pool 'hosted-gpu-prod-3' saturating. Auto-scaler reports repeated failure to provision additional nodes. Please join #incidents.
maya (oncall): I'm on it, grabbing context. What metrics are we seeing?
raj (sre): p95 token latency jumped from 280ms -> 1.6s, p99 ~ 4.8s. Queue depth for model-family 'gptx-30b-q' is 4800 requests, normal ~200. GPU utilization at 99% across pool.
christina (eng-runtime): Autoscaler logs show repeated provisioning timeouts: "instance launch timed out after 300s" and then quota-error 403 for a couple of attempts. Also GPU driver restarts on two nodes in the last 15m.
maya (oncall): Any customer-facing errors? Timeouts or 429s?
leon (support): Some customers are reporting timeouts & 504s when using longer streaming sessions. Support has 6 EM tickets flagged as high-impact. No billing/charge issues reported yet.
maya (oncall): Ops plan: 1) assess capacity, 2) enable mitigations (rate limit/burst control + model fallback), 3) attempt manual scale or cross-region failover. Raj, can you pull autoscaler events and quota state?
raj (sre): Pasting recent autoscaler snippet:
```
2026-03-15T02:11:12Z ERROR provisioner: launch failed: API quota_exceeded for instance-type a2-highgpu-1
2026-03-15T02:13:08Z WARN retrying launch (attempt 3)
2026-03-15T02:16:15Z ERROR instance-xyz kernel panic - restarting
```
raj (sre): Cloud quota looks at limit for GPU instances in us-west-2: currently at 120, in-use 118, pending 6. So we can't satisfy requests; provisioning attempts get rejected.
christina (eng-runtime): We can enable fast fallback routing to 'gptx-30b-quant' (lower memory, slightly slower quality) and to regional replica 'us-east-1' if traffic policy allows. We also have prefix cache for hot prompts — enabling aggressive cache should reduce load.
maya (oncall): Leon, can support message customers about graceful degradation and ETA? We should give timelines: initial mitigations 10-15m, full remediation depends on quota increase.
leon (support): I'll post a short message in customer-status: "We are experiencing elevated latencies and intermittent timeouts in us-west-2. We are mitigating with reduced model capacity and fallbacks; traffic will be redistributed. We'll share updates in 15 minutes." :phone:
ops-bot: Incident created: I-2026-0315-113. Severity: sev2. Runbook: gpu-exhaustion.
maya (oncall): Action items: A) Enable global fallback routing (christina) B) Apply temporary token-per-minute rate cap for free-tier (maya) C) Try manual hot-add of existing spare nodes from other pools (raj) D) Request emergency quota bump from cloud (christina)
christina (eng-runtime): Enabling fallback routing now -> rolling config change: `route.policy.fallback = ['gptx-30b-quant', 'gptx-13b']`.
maya (oncall): Applying temporary rate cap: `policy.limits.free-tier=50rpm` across us-west-2 edge LB. Deploying.
raj (sre): Manual reallocation: draining noncritical batch jobs and moving two spare GPUs from 'research-burst' pool into hosted-gpu-prod-3. Doing now. ETA 6-8 minutes.
christina (eng-runtime): I've also enabled aggressive KV prefix cache for top 5 endpoints, TTL 10m. This should cut repeated prefix work.
incidents-bot: :white_check_mark: change accepted by config-service, rollout started.
maya (oncall): Customer impact estimate: currently ~25% of requests in region are seeing increased latency/timeouts. After fallbacks/rate-limits we expect drop to ~10-12% residual issues. Leon keep customer comms posted.
leon (support): Posted update to customers. Notifying top 10 affected accounts via SRE on-call.
raj (sre): GPUs reallocated, two nodes added in 3m, but autoscaler still failing for new launches due to quota. Pool capacity improved by ~16% from manual moves.
christina (eng-runtime): Routing changes completed: approx 35% of the backlog has been rerouted to quant models and to us-east-1. Streaming sessions that require pinned GPUs are still affected.
maya (oncall): Any errors from fallback path? Need to watch quality/regression metrics.
christina (eng-runtime): Quick checks: hallucination/quality signals look within expected delta for fallback. We'll run a rapid eval on baseline prompts.
raj (sre): p95 down to 560ms, p99 down to 1.8s, queue depth 1200 and decreasing. We're still seeing some 504s for long streaming requests.
maya (oncall): Good. Next: open a quota case with cloud support, and prep a rollback plan if the fallback causes unexpected regressions.
incidents-bot: :information_source: oncall-handoff scheduled: maya -> next_oncall at 1989992000 (09:00 UTC).
leon (support): Will follow up with customers after handoff. Anything else before I close the high-impact customer thread?
maya (oncall): Keep it open until p99 < 2s and queue < 500 for 30m. Handing active tasks to raj for monitoring and christina for runtime config.
raj (sre): I'll keep watch on autoscaler and instance events. If quota request approved we'll attempt autoscale again and then drain the manual nodes back.
christina (eng-runtime): Logging the config changes and adding regression checkpoints to Optimize dashboard.
maya (oncall): Thanks team. Postmortem owners: raj (infra auto-scaling), christina (runtime/fallback), leon (customer comms). I'll kick off incident doc after stable.
incidents-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident I-2026-0315-113 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Updates to follow in incident doc.
